今日页的输入框和右下角的小帮手也写在这里: The Today box and the assistant in the corner write here too
已归档；继续发言不会改变归档状态: Archived; writing here again keeps it archived
用一句话让 Crossline 查、改、安排；每一步查了什么都看得到，改动先确认: Ask Crossline in one sentence to look up, change or schedule; every lookup is shown, and every change is confirmed first and can be undone.
在小帮手页面打开，可看工具调用与全部对话: Open on the assistant page, with every lookup and every conversation
对整个系统的长期偏好：每个环节每次运行都会读到。安全边界和需要你确认的事不受它影: Standing preferences for the whole system: every step reads them on every run. They do not change the safety boundaries or what needs your confirmation. You can also tell the assistant.
例如：回答先给结论再给理由；晚上十点后不要提醒学习的事；称呼我小严: For example: answer first, then the reasons; no study reminders after 10 pm; call me Yan
之后每个环节的每次运行都会读到这段话，作为你的偏好；安全边界和需要你确认的事不受: From now on every step reads these words on every run, as your preferences; they do not change the safety boundaries or what needs your confirmation
各输入框是否显示麦克风；关闭后不再录音: Whether text boxes show the microphone; when off, nothing is recorded
之后的语音输入按这种语言识别: Later voice input is recognised in this language
语音转成文字后是否改正错字与标点: Whether typos and punctuation are corrected after speech becomes text
之后在本人 Codex 上的运行用更低或更高的推理强度；更强更慢、更费额度: Later runs on your own Codex use lower or higher reasoning effort; higher is slower and uses more quota
这段时间内不记录屏幕活动，到时自动恢复（0 为立即恢复）: No screen activity is recorded for this long, then recording resumes by itself (0 resumes now)
窗口标题含这些词（逗号分隔）的活动不记录标题: Activity whose window title contains these words (comma separated) is recorded without its title
关闭即删除已存的位置: Turning it off deletes the stored location
